summary.text: Carlos Gonzalez is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the 10th Hampden District since 2015 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 1 Democratic primary.

paragraphs.text: Gonzalez took office in the Massachusetts House of Representatives on January 7, 2015.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the House Ethics, Human Resources and Employee Engagement, Operations, Facilities and Security, House Rules, and Rules Joint committees; in 2023-2024 he chaired the Public Safety and Homeland Security Joint Committee.
